thag17.2:1.1: yathācārī yathāsato satimā yathā saṃkappacariyāya appamatto ajjhattarato susamāhitatto eko santusito, tam āhu bhikkhuṃ. || ||
thag17.2:2.1: allaṃ sukkhaṃ ca bhuñjanto na bāḷhaṃ suhito siyā, ūnūdaro mitāhāro sato bhikkhu paribbaje. || ||
thag17.2:3.1: cattāro pañca ālope abhutvā udakaṃ pive, alaṃ phāsuvihārāya pahitattassa bhikkhuno. || ||
thag17.2:4.1: kappiyatañ ca ādeti cīvaraṃ idamatthikaṃ, alaṃ phāsuvihārāya pahitattassa bhikkhuno. || ||
thag17.2:6.1: yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda, dukkhaṃ addakkhi sallato, ubhayantarena nāhosi, kena lokasmi kiṃ siyā. || ||
thag17.2:7.1: mā me kadāci pāpiccho kusīto hīnavīriyo appassuto anādaro, kena lokasmi kiṃ siyā. || ||
thag17.2:8.1: bahussuto ca medhāvī sīlesu susamāhito cetosamatham anuyutto api muddhani tiṭṭhatu. || ||
thag17.2:9.1: yo papañcam anuyutto papañcābhirato mago, virādhayī so nibbānaṃ yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ. || ||
thag17.2:10.1: yo ca papañcaṃ hitvāna nippapañcapathe rato, ārādhayī so nibbānaṃ yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ. || ||
thag17.2:11.1: gāme vā yadi vāraññe ninne vā yadi vā thale, yattha arahanto viharanti, taṃ bhūmiṃ rāmaṇeyyakaṃ. || ||
thag17.2:12.1: ramaṇīyā araññāni, yattha na ramatī jano, vītarāgā ramissanti, na te kāmagavesino. || ||
thag17.2:13.1: nidhīnaṃ va pavattāraṃ yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje; tādisaṃ bhajamānassa seyyo hoti na pāpiyo. || ||
thag17.2:14.1: ovadeyyānusāseyya asabbhā ca nivāraye, sataṃ hi so piyo hoti asataṃ hoti appiyo. || ||
thag17.2:15.1: aññassa bhagavā buddho dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā; dhamme desiyamānamhi sotam odhesiṃ atthiko. || ||
thag17.2:16.1: tam me amoghaṃ savanaṃ, vimutto 'mhi anāsavo.
thag17.2:17.1: n' eva pubbenivāsāya na pi dibbassa cakkhuno || || cetopariyāyaiddhiyā cutiyā upapattiyā sotadhātuvisuddhiyā paṇidhī me na vijjati. || ||
thag17.2:18.1: rukkhamūlaṃ va nissāya muṇḍo saṃghāṭipāruto paññāya uttamo thero Upatisso 'va jhāyati. || ||
thag17.2:19.1: avitakkaṃ samāpanno sammāsambuddhasāvako ariyena tuṇhibhāvena upeto hoti tāvade. || ||
thag17.2:20.1: yathāpi pabbato selo acalo supatiṭṭhito, evaṃ mohakkhayā bhikkhu pabbato va na vedhati. || ||
thag17.2:21.1: anaṅgaṇassa posassa niccaṃ sucigavesino vālaggamattaṃ pāpassa abbhāmattaṃ va khāyati. || ||
thag17.2:22.1: nābhinandāmi maraṇaṃ nābhinandāmi jīvitaṃ, nikkhipissaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ sampajāno patissato. || ||
thag17.2:24.1: ubhayenam idaṃ maraṇam eva nāmaraṇaṃ pacchā vā pure vā; paṭipajjatha mā vinassatha, khaṇo ve mā upaccagā. || ||
thag17.2:25.1: nagaraṃ yathā paccantaṃ guttaṃ santarabāhiraṃ evaṃ gopetha attānaṃ, khaṇo ve mā upaccagā, khaṇātītā hi socanti nirayamhi samappitā. || ||
thag17.2:26.1: upasanto uparato mantabhāṇī anuddhato dhunāti pāpake dhamme dumapattaṃ va māluto. || ||
thag17.2:27.1: upasanto --pa-- abbahi pāpake dhamme dumapattaṃ va māluto. || ||
thag17.2:28.1: upasanto anāyāso vippasannamanāvilo kalyāṇasīlo medhāvī dukkhass' antakaro siyā. || ||
thag17.2:29.1: na vissase ekatiyesu evaṃ agārisu pabbajitesu cāpi; sādhū pi hutvāna asādhu honti, asādhu hutvā puna sādhu honti. || ||
thag17.2:30.1: kāmacchando ca byāpādo thīnamiddhañ ca bhikkhuno uddhaccaṃ vicikicchā ca pañca te cittakelisā. || ||
thag17.2:31.1: yassa sakkariyamānassa asakkārena c' ūbhayaṃ samādhi na vikampati appamādavihārino: || ||
thag17.2:32.1: taṃ jhāyinaṃ sātatikaṃ sukhumadiṭṭhivipassakaṃ upādānakkhayārāmaṃ āhu sappuriso iti. || ||
thag17.2:33.1: mahāsamuddo pathavī pabbato anilo pi ca upamāya na yujjanti satthu varavimuttiyā. || ||
thag17.2:34.1: cakkānuvattako thero mahāñāṇī samāhito pathavāpaggi samāno na rajjati na dussati. || ||
thag17.2:35.1: paññāpāramitaṃ patto mahābuddhi mahāmuni ajaḷo jaḷasamāno sadā carati nibbuto. || ||
thag17.2:37.1: appamādena, esā me anusāsanī; handāhaṃ parinibbissaṃ, vippamutto 'mhi sabbadhīti. || || Sāriputto thero.
